description: Schema for external runtime refinement receipts. Actual receipts are CI artifacts produced by the external runtime through its formal public entry; they are never committed to this repository.

required_fields.lmm_commit: 40-hex commit bound to the expected fixture
required_fields.runtime_build_id: build identity of the external runtime
required_fields.fixture_digest: sha256 over the expected fixture body
required_fields.source_snapshot_digests: sorted list of source snapshot digests
required_fields.rule_pack_digest: sha256 over the rule pack content
required_fields.cases: per-case actual statuses keyed by case_id
required_fields.execution_status: SUCCESS | UNKNOWN | TIMEOUT | SKIP | NOT_RUN | BACKEND_UNAVAILABLE | ERROR

prohibited: Same-process shadow statuses as actual receipts.
Editing expected fixtures to match actual results.
Declaring refinement beyond the bound commits and fixtures.
